title: Paper Towel Holder Wall Mount 15.5-Inch | Matte White | Brass Paper Towel Holders | Allied Brass
description:
Free up countertop space and keep paper towels within easy reach at the prep sink or cooking zone in Matte White, which brings clean, fresh simplicity that brightens spaces and creates a light, airy kitchens atmosphere. This wall mount paper towel holder adds an industrial pipe-fitting look that works with transitional kitchens and coordinating versatile accessories.

Highlights:
- Choose from 19 designer finishes to match the rest of your kitchen
- Add an industrial accent—Pipeline-inspired pipe fitting design blends with modern and traditional decor
- Enjoy a clean, decorative look—protected with a highly durable powder coat finish
- Count on lasting performance—materials resist corrosion and rust for continual service
- Install with a matched look—includes color coordinated mounting hardware

Specs & Installation:
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 15.5 x 3 x 4 in.
- Shipping weight: 1.3 lbs
- Hardware: Color coordinating screws included
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
Multiple designer finish options available (19 finishes)
